description: This file defines repository classes for database operations in the Sports Telecast Backend project. It encapsulates CRUD operations and complex queries for entities like users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, and highlights, using SQLAlchemy ORM with async support.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Provides common database operations for repositories via an async session.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Handles database operations related to users such as creation, retrieval, and updates.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Handles database operations related to user profiles.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Contains methods to retrieve and manipulate match data, including filtering and complex 'more matches' logic.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Provides access to event data with filtering options.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Manages emoji assets and reactions, including adding reactions and summarizing reaction data.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Handles retrieval of highlight clips, including featured highlights.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with provided user data and hashed password.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates existing user information with new data.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user profile with the given profile data.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a profile by profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates profile fields based on provided data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of matches with optional filtering by status and sport.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a match by its ID along with related data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Fetches all matches currently marked as live.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming matches within a specified future window.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Provides a curated set of various types of matches for 'more matches' display, prioritizing live, recent, and upcoming matches while avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events with optional filtering.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches an event record by its ID, including matched data.

methods.name: List[EmojiAssetDB] get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active emoji assets.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific emoji asset by its ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str, created_at: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Adds a new emoji reaction for a user on an event/match.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Summarizes reactions for an event, returning counts, top emojis, and other statistics.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of highlights, optionally filtered by match.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a highlight clip by its ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of the most recent and popular highlights for display.

methods.name: __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: unavailable
